name: Sonoco Plastics
old_description: Sonoco is a globally recognized manufacturer of custom and off-the-shelf plastic solutions for a broad spectrum of applications.
about:
Sonoco Plastics, based in Greer, South Carolina, traces its roots to 1946 when it was established as the Industrial & Specialty Plastics division of Sonoco Products Company (NYSE: SON). The division operates as part of the publicly traded packaging conglomerate, leveraging global facilities to deliver custom and off-the-shelf plastic solutions.

The company specializes in plastic injection molding, extrusion, and assembly, supported by in-house design, engineering, and quality teams. Its capabilities include high-speed automation molding, insert and overmolding, two-shot robotic production, in-mold labeling, and food-grade molding. Sonoco also provides tool design, prototyping, mold making, and multi-process integration for efficient assembly of components such as living hinges, multi-piece assemblies, and fuse collars.

Sonoco serves automotive manufacturers requiring ISO/IATF 16949:2016-compliant parts, medical device makers needing ISO Class 7 and 8 cleanroom components, and filtration markets with engineered cores and cages. It also supplies FSSC 22000-certified consumer and pharmaceutical packaging, foodservice smallware for quick-service restaurants (including patented Accu-Salt and Accu-Taste dispensers), and industrial products such as spools, reels, cores, endwalls, and textile carriers for wire and cable.

The division emphasizes innovation and speed, promoting the fastest turnaround times in the industry and a model that moves projects from concept to production quickly through integrated design, engineering, and quality support.
